A timeless classic with a delicate and creamy touch! This soft, moist cake is layered with light vanilla frosting and topped with a silky vanilla glaze. With its simple yet irresistible flavor, it’s a perfect choice for those who love an elegant and comforting dessert.


Product Details:

  • Type: Cream Cake (Eggless)
  • Weight: 300g
  • Shape: Round | Size: ~4 inches
  • Flavour: Vanila | Serves: 2-3 people
  • Origin: India

Care Instructions:

  • Store cream cakes in the refrigerator.
  • Fondant cakes should be kept in a cool, air-conditioned space.
  • Serve at room temperature, avoiding heat exposure.
  • Use a serrated knife for cutting fondant cakes.
  • Decorative elements may have toothpicks or wires—check before serving.
  • Consume within 24 hours for best taste.

Delivery Information:

  • Cakes are handcrafted; slight variations in design & shape may occur.
  • Delivery time is an estimate based on availability & location.
  • We attempt delivery only once as cakes are perishable.
  • Address changes post-order are not possible.
  • Actual product may slightly differ from the image shown.
  • Hand-delivered, not shipped via courier.

• • Flavour/design substitutions may occur due to regional availability.
